narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>five point five overs is five overs and three balls, since half of six is three.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the digit after the point counts balls, so five means five balls.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>This notation looks like a decimal, and it is not one.
